rules-320.text: The match on screen is real and plays like football: your Squad against today's rival decides who is favourite, but favourites drop points and plenty of matches end level. Against a rival as strong as you, you expect about 1.45 goals to their 1.17, and each Squad level adds about 0.05 of a goal a match to your side and takes as much off theirs. A goal pays 5 seconds of your income, a win 20 seconds and going up a division 2 minutes, and wins extend a streak that multiplies everything and pulls in new fans. Every division up sends stronger rivals, and they stay that strong until you win the league.
